correctness.rationale: Reversing one-symbol duplication with transposition amounts to deleting a nonfirst occurrence of a symbol. Deleting two positions produces the same parent exactly when every symbol between them is constant, so each eligible constant run contributes exactly one distinct parent and precisely the singleton first run of each symbol is ineligible. Hence \(|P(y)|=r(y)-s(y)\). The maximum follows from run count versus distinct-symbol count, and summing run counts minus singleton-first-run counts over all received words gives the stated global edge formula. Fresh exhaustive generation for \(q=2,3\) and \(1\le n\le4\) reproduced the pointwise law, maxima and edge counts.
